pc.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: PC desktop website background, a single standalone environment illustration, strictly horizontal widescreen 16:9 composition, high resolution.
Primary request: Create a beautiful premium Genshin Impact / Teyvat themed background for a Chinese character voice archive website. This is actual scenic background artwork, not a webpage mockup.
Scene/backdrop: Mondstadt's Windrise at luminous blue hour just after sunset. The great ancient Windrise oak frames the far left edge with graceful branches and softly glowing foliage, a small recognizable Anemo Statue of the Seven beneath it near the left shoreline. A tranquil broad lake opens across the middle, distant Mondstadt city with its distinctive windmills, stone walls and cathedral on the right horizon, very distant Dragonspine snowy peaks, a tiny floating Celestia silhouette high in the vast starry sky. Cecilia flowers and a few dandelions at the bottom corners. Gentle clouds, subtle blue-green Anemo fireflies and sparse floating golden motes. No characters.
Style/medium: polished Genshin Impact in-game environmental key art, elegant anime fantasy landscape, painterly cel-shaded lighting, crisp carefully designed silhouettes, delicate hand-painted textures and convincing atmospheric perspective, extraordinarily beautiful but calm. Avoid photorealism and avoid generic science fiction.
Composition/framing: Landscape 16:9, immersive wide panorama with layered foreground, water, distant city and sky. Keep the center 60 percent unusually open and low in local contrast: smooth lake, mist, broad sky, no central tree, no large structures or bright ornament behind website copy and character cards. Place the detailed foreground tree and landmark city on opposite outer sides. Do not put a frame around the image. The view must extend naturally to all four edges.
Lighting/mood: serene magical evening, soft moonlit silver edges, a thin warm champagne glow on the horizon, luminous depth without overexposure, rich readable shadow detail. The world feels inviting, airy and distinctly Mondstadt.
Color palette: sophisticated midnight azure, teal and jade green, muted lavender-blue sky, restrained champagne gold lights and soft ivory flowers; harmonious with dark transparent navy glass and golden character cards.
Constraints: Single background image only. No UI, no cards, no interface, no lettering, no Chinese characters, no logo, no watermark, no border, no modern buildings, no science fiction circuitry, no large glowing geometric shapes. Sparse particles only, keep the visual center clean. Horizontal image, not a collage or comparison panel.

mobile.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: smartphone website background, a single standalone environment illustration, strictly VERTICAL PORTRAIT 9:16 composition, high resolution.
Input images: Image 1 is a visual reference for the world, colors, art direction and landmark design only. Create a newly composed portrait illustration of the same Mondstadt Windrise blue-hour scene; do not crop the horizontal reference or place it on a phone mockup.
Primary request: Genshin Impact / Teyvat themed mobile web background, premium anime fantasy environmental key art matching the supplied landscape. The same Windrise ancient oak, Anemo Statue of the Seven, distant Mondstadt windmills and cathedral, Dragonspine peaks and tiny Celestia floating in a vast starry sky.
Composition/framing: Strict 9:16 vertical canvas. The oak trunk hugs the extreme left edge and branches form a gentle corner canopy only in the upper left; a small cyan-glowing winged Anemo statue sits well left of center near the shore. Far away across the lake, place a small richly designed Mondstadt skyline with recognizable windmills and cathedral near the right side around the lower-middle horizon, snow peaks behind it. Keep the central column 65 percent of the width quiet and unobstructed over nearly the full height: broad smooth navy-blue starlit sky blending into atmospheric lavender mist and tranquil reflective lake. Fine white Cecilia flowers and dandelions tucked only into the bottom corners. Leave the upper center open for a heading and the lower central region open behind a scrolling character-card grid. Portrait world-space composition, NOT a zoomed or vertically stretched landscape.
Style/medium: refined Genshin Impact environmental key art, painterly anime illustration with delicate cel-shaded lighting, graceful natural forms, detailed but restrained foreground, deep atmospheric perspective. Match the supplied reference's craft and beautiful Mondstadt mood.
Lighting/mood: tranquil magical twilight, deep clear blue sky and stars, softly lit jade foliage, restrained Anemo cyan motes, a thin champagne-gold twilight horizon, warm city pinlights reflected in cool water. Rich readable shadows. Elegant and peaceful rather than visually busy.
Color palette: same midnight azure, cyan-teal, jade, lavender blue, restrained warm champagne and ivory as the reference. Designed to sit behind navy transparent glass and gold character cards.
Constraints: One portrait background illustration only, edge-to-edge scenery. No characters or faces, no user interface, no text, no logos, no watermark, no decorative frame, no collage, no phone device, no sci-fi circuitry. No bright large object in the central area, sparse subtle particles only. The actual output canvas must be vertical, taller than it is wide.
